title: Timing Surcharge on Kestrel Advantage Balloon Refinances Completed After Maturity
content:
**Rate note — refinancing after the maturity date.** The refinance APR of a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract is raised when the refinance date falls after the maturity date:

| Refinance date | Raise of the refinance APR |
|---|---|
| More than 15 calendar days after the maturity date | 0.5 percentage points |
| 1 to 15 calendar days after the maturity date | 0.25 percentage points |
| On or before the maturity date | None |

Calendar days from the maturity date to the refinance date count the refinance date and not the maturity date.

## Boundary cases (maturity on the 10th)

| Refinance date | Days after maturity | Raise |
|---|---|---|
| The 10th | 0 | None |
| The 11th | 1 | 0.25 |
| The 25th | 15 | 0.25 |
| The 26th | 16 | 0.5 |
